question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer: Lootugo fuutere nden bee ndiyam e saabunde lawlaw ko kuugal lobbal masin, amma ɓingel ngel haandi heɓa bakkal *Rabies* (vaccine) hannde-hannde ngam faddaago nyawu boosaaru ndun. Ngam boosaaru ndun meɗai heɓugo bakkal, nyawu mbuuɓri ndin waawan naatugo nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel, to ngu naati bo walaa safaara baawɗo hisnugo yonki maagel. Ha asibiti, likitaajo hokkan ɓingel ngel lekki buuɓri (antibiotics) e bakkal *Tetanus* ngam faddaago fuutere nden nyo'ugo. Likitto'en nyo'ata (suture) fuutere ngati boosaaru lawlaw ngam taa nyawu ngun lumba nder ɓandu ɓingel ngel. Ndan wakkilan woydu ɓingel ngel asibiti mawndi ngam ngel heɓa bakkal *Rabies* hannde-hannde walaa fasaago ngam hisnugo nguurndam maagel.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Bana no o lari alamaaji ɗi'i, hunde satiŋde nder endi fuɗɗi naawugo be ɓuutuwa, ɗum ɗo nufa endi man heɓi mboordi (pewuri) ko bo ketungol nyau daji (kansa). Mboordi ko daji nder endi ɗo waɗa ɓuudi satiŋdi, ɗo naawa, bo babal man ɗo woya ngam kwayaaji nyau ɗon mooɓta nder ɗon. O haandi o yaha asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mema lara endi man, ɓe waɗa hoto (scan) ngam ɓe tabaatika asali ɓuudi man. To ɓe tawi nyau man law, likita hokkan mo magani ko ɓe waɗa seere pamarde ngam ittugo ɗum, ngam non taa o fasa ko o mema ɗum kanko e hoore mako ngam ta nyau man ɓedda.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
reference:
Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer: Nyau ngu debbo on wondi e mum waawi wonugo tuuɗugo redu ɗuɗngo (Hyperemesis) hawti e doggu-doggu koo nyau paɓɓooji (malaria), ɗum waɗi o sooyti ndiyam ɓandu nden o lo'i masin. Lekki ki o ɓuri haajaago jooni-jooni woni ndiyam gishiri e suga (ORS) ngam o heɓta ndiyam e sembe ɗam o sooyti e ɓandu mako. O haani o yaha asibiti lau ngam likitajo hokka mo ndiyam rooba (IV fluids) to o waawataa yarugo, hawti e lekki tuuɗugo ki naunataa ɓingel redu. Ha asibiti man, ɓe ƴeewan ƴii'am mako ngam anndugo to omo woodi malaria koo typhoid ngam o heɓa magani ki dagi debbo redujo yara. Taa o hoosa lekki leɗɗe koo kuyeji ɗi likitaajo yamiraai ngam taa ɗum wonna redu ndu koo nauna ɓingel.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer: Ɓingel ma ɗon holla alamaaji nyau nawɗum je gaba bee pofɗe, waato *Pneumonia* ko *Asthma*, ngam fofugo mako ɗon tiiɗi sosai. Sauti hendu ɗum a nana, nasta-wurtugo gaba mako, bee laawuɗum nyamugo ɗon holla ɓingel heɓataa foofande (oxygen) ko he'i nder ɓandu. Lekki ɗojjugo je a soodi haa kemis waawataa safrigo ngal nyawu, ngam ɗum haaje lekki asibiti mawndi naa je meere. Dan Allah, taa fasa wakkati be lekki saare, doggu yahru ɓingel asibiti jotta-jotta ngam likita'en ndokka mo *oxygen* bee lekki mbarmu gaba. Nyau man ɗon mari hatsari masin, ngam majjum wurtin mo asibiti lawlaw koo o heɓa jam.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Bana likitaajo, ɗuuɓu njuutngu ngu lebbi ɗuuɗɗi, ngu yahu-taa e leɗɗe koo safaare asali, ɗon holla sikke nyawu Tii-Bii (Tuberculosis) koo nyawu ɓimɓiniingu (lungs) mangom. Safaare asali bana jumri, ndiyam nguleeɗam, e goro njum ɗon de'ina daande tan, ammaa ɗi mbaawataa mbardugo kulɓooji (bacteria) tiiɗɗi mbaɗɗi nyawu ngu'u. Suberu haani yaha asibiti laamu jooni-jooni ngam ɓe ƴeewa tuttudu (sputum) maako e hoto gadi (chest X-ray) ngam anndugo tigi-tigi ko waddi nyawu man. To ɓe tawi koo Tii-Bii (TB) on, safaare man walaa ceede haa asibitiiji laamu nder Naajeeriya, kadi o yamɗitan pat to o hooyi leɗɗe bana no ɓe umri mo. O acca soodugo leɗɗe meere e kemis, o hokka asibiti damba ngam o heɓa yamɗitugo kadi o foofa jam.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer: Rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɓuri waddata ɗum kanjum on laasol danyugo tayaaki boɗɗum, lura (placenta) heddi nder bandu, koo bo tayugo ɓandu wakkati danyugo. Ngam iyam mai dara be o heɓa sembe, sey o kwanta haa sibiti lawlaw heɓa ɓe lumba mo ndiyam (IV fluids), ɓe ɓesda mo iyam ngam sembe lora, denbo ɓe hokka mo leɗɗe bano *Oxytocin* koo *Misoprostol* ngam taya laasol danyugo. To lura on heddi nder mako, likitajo woggata nder laasol danyugo mai laaɓa, o hokka mo leɗɗe *antibiotics* ngam taa nyau nasta mo. Shawara am haa maɓɓe kanjum on; debbo danyiɗo mai sey nyama nyamdu sembindinndu ɓandu mari *iron* bana kusel, nyebbe, be haakooji ngam iyam mako lora law, denbo o tokka hokkugo ɓingel mako endi wakkati fuu.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Alaamaji ɗi on mbiyi bana naawol hoore jamma, daande tiiɗnde, gite mbawataa laarugo annoora (hite), bee fofe vurtooje haa ɓandu ɗon holla nyawu nguykinoowu bi'eteengu Sankarau (Meningococcal Meningitis). Nyawu ngu'u raabotoongu masin, ngu ɗon yaara puyooje bee mbuuwu (bacteria) nder ndiyam hoore bee ɓawo, ngam maajum o waawataa waylitugo daande maako. Ngam tabbatingo nyawu man, likita'en haani ɓe koo'a ƴiiƴam maako malla ɓe njuwa kunkuru ɓawo maako ɓe hoo'a ndiyam (lumbar puncture) ngam laarugo nder masin asibiti (lab test). Amma ngam Sankarau ɗon wara neɗɗo lawlaw, taa munnee haa sakamakko warta; on dila hokke mo lekki tufooji ndiyam (IV antibiotics) bana *Ceftriaxone* jooni-jooni ngam hisnugo yonki maako. O haani o rumbine haa suudu asibiti mawnundu lawlaw ngam heɓugo lura, nden yimɓe wuro maako bo haani ɓe hokke lekki ngam taa ɓe raabe.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
reference:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗi lari bana doju fajira ɓurtungu, tampiri lau, e sooynde foofugo ɗon holla gorko mako waawi woodugo nyaw ɓerde (heart failure), nyaw TB (doyru), ko boo nyaw lokuɗe/jofɗe ngam taba ko cuuɗi. Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓerde walaa sembe wurtinki yiiyam no haandi, ko boo mboros nyaw bonni lokuɗe maako, ɗum boo no ɗuɗɗum nder gure meeɗen. Eey, nyawuuji ɗi ɗon nawa ɓerde, ɗi ɗon fadda foofugo, nden ɗi waawi warugo neɗɗo to o welaaki asibiti lau ngam heɓugo lekki. Alamaji kulniiɗi ɗi handi on ɗon hakkilina kanko on: to o fuɗɗi tuutugo yiiyam, to kosɗe maako ɗon ɓuuta, ko boo to o waawaa waalugo ledi ngam foofugo ɗon maɓɓa mo. Shawari debbo hokki mo ngam yaha asibiti be waɗa hoto gite (X-ray) e teendugo (tests) woni laawol ɓurngol wooɗugo ngam heɓugo jam e hisnugo yonki maako.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
reference:
Jam bandu, miwari gam miniko am , mi laari ni giteji be balli mako do wadi jallo jallo ni. Kuma bani mai ni har kusan balle tati. Bandu mabbe bo do vuli odolla be zaszabi. Bo kuma be wawata yamugo, be wawata jogugo kodume fu haa redu. Bo be do duwna be do sommi wala sembe. Gam hore mabbe do regga, do naawa, be bandu mabbe do wuli. Min godi nafturugo hundeji min mari ha saare, amma wala ko changi sam be damata be. Giteji mabbe be balli mambe je changi colo jallo do har jotta dillai, do bedda beddugo tan kullum, be wala der jam, be yamdai. Bedo yara bone. Kanjum wadi Allah haddu , bedo nana bone sosai.
Kanjum wadi mi wari sibiti heba min handa komin taakata, heba bandu miniko am, balli be giteji je wadata jallo do hachai be haunai.
model_answer: Sannu mon, alaamaji gite e ɓandu ooldi (jaundice), zazzaɓi nguli, naawalla hoore, e tuutuɗi ɗi on limti ɗon holla alhaali nyawu pabbooje (severe malaria) cattuɗum, yellow fever, ko bo nyawu nawa-heenyere (hepatitis). Ngam ledde asali wawaay wallugo bo oolde man ɗon ɓesda, min ɗon ƴeewa ƴiiƴam maako jooni-jooni ngam min tabbitina asali nyawu nguu nden min ndaara no heenyere maako huuwatirta. Min ɗon fukkina mo haa sibiti (admit) ngam min loka mo ndiyam nder ɗaɗol (drip) e leɗɗe nyawu pabbooje cattuɗe ngam o darna tuutuɗi, o heɓa sauki lawlaw. On waɗi ko woodi on ngaddi mo sibiti, ammaa mbalee acce hokkaago mo ledde asali kadi ngam ɗi ɗon ɓesda bonnugo heenyere maako. Insha Allahu to min fuɗɗi hokkugo mo leɗɗe sibiti e ndiyam, zazzaɓi e naawalla man ɗon usta, gite maako bo ɗon fuɗɗa laaɓugo.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
reference:
Bingel am  wadi reedu;  duɓi makọ woɗa lasọ  ẹ nayi. Kankơ nọn mọ wodi redu. Kọ fayti hanɗẹ bọ.
Jemma, mi hissi ọɗọ wondi nauɗu. Ọ arti  ọ mofti  karẹ makọ ,ọ wari wurọ am. Nauɗu mei  ɓeidi ,ndẹ mi lari nawɗum makọ darai, mi mofti karẹ makọ, arandẹ  kam  o ƴiɗa mi yaramo Nyaudọrdẹ .  Mi yari mọ Nyaudọrdẹ  ɓẹ larimọ. Ɓẹ wi'i rimirdẹ makọ fuɗi nọ maɓitọ, den wakkati o danygol ɓadi.

O wondi  nawɗum, cukaley makọ wurtay,  reedu makọ arandẹ ọn. Hakkilo am ummi , ɓẹrne am de itaaki.
Mi ƴidi mi yida ɓingel am, mi ŷiɗa mi soya ɓingel am nge warata do.  
Useini,ɗumẹ fọɗata nawɗum on?  Non daynrgol arandẹ wa' i na?
Ɗun watọn na ɓẹ wi'a ɓingel fotay wurta heedi alaura ? Ko ɓọ dun sẹkan mo?
model_answer:
A sannu bee tiiɗal, naawalla ɗi ɓiɗɗo maaɗa reeduujo ɗon nana bee rimirde maɓɓunde ɗon holla caɗeele danyaaki (prolonged labor) ɗi haandi heɓa magani haa asibiti lawlaw. 

Alura ɗi likitotooɓe asibiti njiɗi fukkugo mo (oxytocin drip) laawol goongawol ngam wallugo rimirde maako maɓɓita, ngam o danya bee jam. 

To ɗum waɗaaka koo bo laawol maɓɓitataa, naawalla man waaway wanngina caɗeele maayde haa dow danyayɗo bee ɓingel nder reedu maako. 

To alura nden wallaayi, likitotooɓe ɗon mbaawi seekugo mo (C-section/operation) ngam hisnugo yonki maɓɓe ɓe ɗiɗo. 

Taa huli koo haaƙilo ma ummo, hokku likitotooɓe laawol ɓe kuuha kuugal maɓɓe ngam ɗum on laawol anndal ɓurngal hisnugo ɓingel maaɗa bee taaniraawo ma.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. Re min wawata waɗugo hala salare kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma ha dou man.
reference: Debbo fere moh dubi chappan eh Didi eh Didi moh danyi ha asibiti balde Tati ko sali waddi bingel mako hande wadugo riga kafi bikkoi kecchon. Deh o wari sei o yechchi Amin bingel doh sali musungo, ha yotti bingel man wala sembe koh sedda boh o danan tan. Ovi bingel man wala joga endi, denbo kodei jungo mako, kosde beh bandu mako pat doh fewi delem har doh hulna moh to’omemi bingel man beh jungo mako, har dikka o hosa moh hader sabbodeh. O hakkilini bingel man sali endi, bandu mako doh fewi to beh memi denbo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala Wawa bamta jungo mako, forta kosde boh o wala dimbah sam, odo wali babal gotel tan. Toh a lari bingel manni odo yonti boh nyaugel. Dimeh Dasi bannin man? Dimeh on a numata dasata bandu bikkoi kecchon fewa delem toh goddo memi? Koh ngam o sali musungo on tan koh ngam dimeh on? Dimeh min wawata wadugo hala salareh kosam endi man? Denbo hala Riga kafi hadi min jabah man dimeh on shawara mah ha Dow man?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗi ɓingel ngel hollata, bana feewgo ɓandu delem, salgo musinugo, e walaa sembe sam, ɗon holla nyaw mawngu (neonatal sepsis/infection) naati nder ƴiiƴam maggel. Feewgo ɓandu bee salgo kosam ɗon dasa ustuki suukara nder ƴiiƴam, ko laati masiba mawɗo sosai haa ɓikkoi keccon ɓe balɗe tati. Ngam majjum, taa waɗu rigaakafi (immunization) hande sam, ngam ɓingel ngel walaa sembe bo ngel ɗon nyawi masin. Shawara am bana likitaajo woni min naatna ɓingel ngel asibiti jotta-jotta, min hokka ngel nguleefi, min fona suukara maggel, nden min fuɗɗa barmel (antibiotics) nder ƴiiƴam ngam kasheego nyaw man. Sai to ngel heɓi jam, ɓandu maggel wuli, nden ngel fuɗɗiti musinugo, on mbaawi lortugo ngam waɗugo rigaakafi man.

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. Bannii tan o laari ɓinngel may ɗo woka nawɗum haa juuɗe be kosɗeeji maako yotti haa ɓinngel may woka ɓe ɓamtan o laada koo o dimba heba o yotta dada maɓɓe puseni ɗume on dada ɗo wannata ɓinngel ɗo hoyna mo nauɗum haa juuɗe bee kosɗeji ɓinngel ɗo bee dada mo ɓinngel Kanjum dada yiɗi wara sibiti be ɓingel mai ɓe lara likita heɓa ɓe hefta ko ɓe wannata ɓe vallita ɓandu ɓingel ɗo o wona o jamu.
reference:
Debbo dayi bingel. Bingel mai leuru jew ko saali. Owadi bayani hala bingel mai, ovi wala damuwa do bingel mai wakati odayi mo, bingel mai do musina sosai bana no haadi,  bani tan o laari bingel mai do wooka naudum ha juude be kostejimako.
Yotti har mingel mai wooka be bamtamo o ladda, ko o dimba, heba oyotta daada mambe.
Useni dume don dada do wannata bingel do, hoinina naudum ha jude be kosteji bingel do, be da darna mounugo bingel mai? Kanjum daada idi wara sibiti, be bingel mai be laara likita heba be hefta ko be wannata be vallita bandu mingel do, o wonna o jamo.
model_answer: Ndaa shawari am, hokka ɓinngel ngel safaara ustata naawalla bana 'Paracetamol' (Panadol) lawlaw, nden taa a foya koo a dimmba juuɗe e kosɗe ɗen ngam taa naawalla man ɓeyda. Ɓinngel lebbi jowi woyugo to ɓe memii koo ɓe ɓamti juuɗe e kosɗe maagel ɗon holla alamaaji nyaw 'Sickle Cell' koo boo nyaw mboowu (infection) nder 'iy'e maagel. Diga asali, nyaw 'Sickle Cell' ɗon fuɗɗa feeñugo haa ɓikkon wakkati ɓe heɓi lebbi jowi koo jeego, ɗon waɗa ɓuudi e naawalla masin haa juuɗe e kosɗe. Yaaru ɓinngel ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en mbaɗa ngel tefoore ƴiiƴam e hooto (X-ray) ngam heɓtugo ko saabani nyaw man. To min heɓtii asali nyaw man, min hokkan ngel safaaraaji mboowu koo min ndaara no min mballirta ngel to 'sickle cell' on ngam ɓandu maagel heɓa laaɓa.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
reference:
Debbo laari gorko mako do mari naawol hore, nawol hore mai voodai sam sam. Nawol hore do , do nawii ni har saida daade mako o tiidii ni, wawata wellutugo nano, nyamo ni bana no haadi. Sai o laari puulel pamari je walano bandu gorko mai amma fudi vurti nonon. Dum hulni debbo mai do irin kuje je fedi do bandu gorko mako, dume don laati hunde mai vurti, kuma dume don owadata? Komiemi debbo mai ba gorko mako medi marugo zaszabi naudum na be kuma lekki toi be naftiri?
Ovi aa.  Ko gorko mai, leso o naanata, do pilo dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba? Ovi aa. Dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba nonnon naawol hore mai wari, sai wardi be tiidol daade. Kuma pullel per pertel vurtinimo ha bandu mako.
Ko irin kuje bani fe’di, dume don irin Debo do wadata vallititta gorko mako be lorninamo bandu bana no wonnon?
model_answer: Alaamaji ɗi debbo on yi'i, bana nawol hoore tiggol, tidingo daande heɗi o waawataa waylitugo, be pitooji ɓandu ɗi walaa noone (petechiae), ɗon holla nyawu *Meningitis* (Sennu-baata koo Mboongu ngaandi) nguu buliingo masin. Nyawu ngu kooɗe (bacteria) waddata ngu naata ƴii'yam be ɓaasiiji ɗonnooji ngaandi, kanko waɗi daande maako tiiɗi, zazzabi wari, ɗaangol ɓaangi, be pitooji vurti. Taa debbo on fasa koo eɓɓa lekki wuro, o doggina gorko maako asibiti lawlaw ngam nyawu ngu e mbaawa hokkugo maayde koo naqasa. Haa asibiti, likita'en ɓe tesa mo alluuraaji maaganiiji (antibiotics) caɗɗi nder daada ƴii'yam ngam mbara kooɗe ɗin, ɓe ndokka mo ndiyam ndartina ɓandu maako. Nguu nyawu ɗon heewi wakkati nguleeki nder leydi meeden, ngam maajum yarugo alluura rigaafi (vaccine) be hebbingo hendu nder cuuɗi ɗon walla kariya saare nden.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwini mo sei o vi o dilli tan o yahi a sibiti heɓa ɓe hefta ko fe’ata be petul damuwa ɗo wawan hoina ɓingal ɗo damuwa ɓerde na ko asma ɗon fe’ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toi ɗon handi ɓingel ɗo handi acca heɓa ko. damata mo wadinta mo o dodda ho’ina mo usta sosai.
reference: Daada  peju, do mari bikkon tati, peju don petel mai . Peju domari dubu gotel. Daada peju mai hirliti bawo palde sedda dai odayi . Peju do mari ye’u dojjugo, kuma tun wakati mai odo ta dojja wala darugo sam . Ovi kuma o hirliti foofugo fu do hokkamo bone.ovi dojjugo do yawanchi do warinamo be kikkide  wakati komai fu nasti do naana. Ovi foofugo mako do sadina mo ofoofa boddum. Kam dojjugo do wala acchamo o foofa o vurtina boddum . Ovi oyahi ha yaudiko gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwunimo. So ovi odilli tan oyahi sibiti heba be o hefta ko fedata be peju. Damuwa do waawan hoyina bingel do na? Damuwa berde na ko asma don feddata be bingel do? Kujeji toi don haadi bingel do haadi accha, heba ko damaatamo wadintamo o dojja hoyinnamo, usta sosai?
model_answer: Alamuuji ɗojugo jemma, iidaango nde o fofata, e saɗugo poofol ɗon holla ɓingel maaɗa ɗon mari nyawu Asma, koo de likitaajo foti lartugo ɓerde maako asibiti ngam tabbitingo. Kuugal boɗɗum ngal a waɗi kanjum woni accugo lekki gargajiya e warugo asibiti, ngam nyawu ngu ɗon haaji lekkiiji asibiti kesi bana "inhaler" ngam maɓɓitugo poofol maako. Ngam ustugo ummugo nyawu man, a haani a reena ɓingel ngel daga kura (sollaare), curki yiite koo sigariiri, jaangol, e uuraaji caɗɗi. Laaɓɓin suudu e gude leeso maako wakkati fuu ngam halkugo dabbaaji kura, kadi a ɓorna mo gude gulɗe ngam reengo mo daga jaangol. Tokkugo umroore likitaajo e hokkugo mo lekki asibiti wakkati fuu wallan ɓingel man fofa boɗɗum, kadi ɗojugo e damuwa man ustoto sosai.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.
reference:
Mi lili bingei am sodan  bafe ewedu ƙeƴa kikiɗe. Hanọ mintaci sappọ e joyi, kosam owarti wuro e owulla.Ko mi ƴami ko fayti, ɓẹ wolwaniya ɓọsaru ngati  kosɗe mako. Mi ƴami mon dume kala bọosaru on, toi  dun ƴuroi ko ɗu boosaru keddiraɓẹ non. Wakkati nden, mi wujani mo ŋebban ha babal boosaru ngati mo, ngam dum wara tọke ɓosaru ɗum.
Sai ɓẹ hokki am shaawori mi yaramo asibiti dayngol dere keddiraɓẹ . Ɓe widdaniyam baatẹ tetanus mi yaha mi sooda ha kemist. Mi soodi baatẹ ọn,dun tufi mo ɗun ƙeƴa. Illa wakkati den, mi yarimọ wurọ amma illa ƙeƴa , futtẹrẹ man ɓuuti , nọgurẹ nọ wooji. Jotta kam ,hakkilo am  ummi  ẹ mi tammi boosaru dun hokki ɓingel am nƴau boosaru.  Mi ɗọ ƴama wodi  lekki kọ mi sodinta na mọ ko bọ mi yara mọ sibbiti ɓẹ  ɓedda larugọ mọ.
model_answer: Yaaru ɓingel ma asibiti mangou jooni-jooni, ngam lekki kemis he'aay ngam fetiya boosaaru, masin to boosaaru ndu anndaaka. Boosaaru ndu waawi raaɓugo ɓingel nyawu boosaaru (rabies) ngu walaa lekki to ngu fanti naatugo ɓandu. Ɓingel ngel ɗon haaji tufle kakkilanooje nyawu boosaaru (anti-rabies vaccine) bee wakkati ngam hisnugo yonki maako. Ɓuuɗi e naawalla haa nokkuure nde boosaaru feti mo holli mbononnda (infection) naati haa asar man, ɗum ɗon haaji laɓɓineego e o heɓa lekki (antibiotics) caahu. Wota a faɓɓu haa wuro, yahu asibiti gidaaji ngam likita'en mbaawa wallugo ɓingel maaku.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.

Gorko am dubi mako cappende ni. Denbo mi hirliti saati tati ko saali do odo fi ta yara diyam sosai sosai. No o yarata deyam mai nonon o sillata. Toh oyari dumdum ma nonnon. Kuma nonnon ma be jamma o finai wadai de sappo, o ummi o yaha o silla. Odo wooka fu, odo nana chomri kullum. Bo odon beddi bandu sedda. Wakati fere odo fi’a o do lara dowre, owala laara boddum to o ummi odo wancha. Mi hirliti odo silla akai akai bo dundum bo. Dumedon watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do? Kwadi oyarata diyam dumdum denbo odo silla duddum? Ko alaamaji do waawan je ye’u shuga, ko hundeji fere don? Haunigo toi be goji toi waddata heba hefta irin ye’u toi don do? Kowadi odo somi kullum do? Dumedon waddata silligo akai akai do? Do sembe eyam mako bamti don waddata ye’u do, ko diyam bandu mako timmi na, ko kujjeji fere don tan? Irin yiiri be kujeji yarugo toi o acchata, kuma dume don haadi odinga yaamugo? 
Mataaki toi ohosata, vallititta alaamaji do? De haadi noi goji be haunugo je Ye’u shuga haadi wada, kullum na ko yandego yandego? Ye’u toi don waddata alaamaji do je fe’data ha bandu mako?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗi a limti ɗo, irin yarugo ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, sillugo koondeye haa e jemma, sombo, e lallaago gite, ɗon holla gorko oo ɗon mari nyau shuga (Diabetes) e tawe ɓamtol ƴiiƴam (Hypertension). Sillugo e ɗonka ɗuɗɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓandu mako ɗon tefa wurtinki shuga ɓurtunɗo nder ƴiiƴam mako ta laawol sille. Diga jooni hani o yaha asibiti ngam likitaajo auna shuga ƴiiƴam mako koo o nyaamai (Fasting Blood Sugar) e ɓetol ƴiiƴam (BP) ngam tabbatingo nyau man e hokkugo mo lekki. Ngam ustugo ɗum, o wajiba o acca yarugo kuuje mari shuga e nyaamduji swiiti, o usta nyaamugo nyiiri ɗuɗɗum, kadi o ɓedda nyaamugo haakooji e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe. Hosaago lekki asibiti e wakkati, tokkugo laawol nyaamdu boɗɗum, e waɗugo jarsiisi wallitan ustugo alamaji ɗi fuu haa o heɓa jam, o hisa daga masibo nyau shuga.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer: Ko addani ma doggudu reedu, fiyannde ɓernde, e sembe ƴiiƴam (high BP) woni kulol e tashin hankali (stress) ɗi gorko ma waɗanta ma, ɗum kadi masibo mawngo haa debbo reeduujo. Accu lekki gargajiya ɗi a hoosata sam, ngam ɗum wawatā safrude nyawu kulol, kadi ɗum waawi naunugo ɓiɗɗo nder reedu ma. A haandi a heɓa lekki sibiti lawlaw ngam jippingo sembe ƴiiƴam ma ngam taa a heɓa nyawu pre-eclampsia nguu waawi warugo ma e ɓiɗɗo. Ngam doggudu reedu e fiyannde ɓernde ndu daro fuf, haaje ma a heɓa jam hakkilo; a haandi a lutta haa nokkuure nde walaa kulol, kadi saare ma malla hukuuma mbaɗa shari'a e gorko ma ngam a heɓa tsira. Minen likita'en min ɗon ɗo ngam wallude ma e lekki kadi e maslaha (counseling) ngam a heɓa jam hakkilo, a danya e jam.

question: Debbo banga on duɓi amin e tati e joi usbi joi on lari amoti kugal ko yali amɗe tati sali ɗo mi hefti o ɗo fi kata ɗoja sosai ko ɗume je darnata. model_answer: Alamaaji ɗoja kalluɗi e saɗugo fofugo ɗi ɓingel ma lebbi jowi mari ɗon holla omo heɓi nyawu puf-puf (pneumonia), nguu nyawu ɗon wada masin bo ngu ɗon mbara ɓikkoi pamari. question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
reference:
Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
model_answer: Waɗugo bulu be saɗugo foofugo ɗon holla ɓingel mai walaa hendu (oxygen) feewi nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum boo ɗon wara koo ngam nyawu pampamje (pneumonia) naawngu koo nyawu ɓernde. Saɗugo heɓugo hendu man on haɗata ɓingel musinugo boɗɗum, ɗum boo ɗon wadda tuutu ngam tiɗɗoore haa foofugo. Ɗum masibo wakkatiiru (emergency), ngam maajum taa ɓe hokka lekki meere, dole likitaajo laara ɓingel mai lawlaw. Ha asibiti, min fuɗɗan hokkugo ɓingel mai hendu (oxygen) wakkati go'o, kamin min bincika ɓernde be pampamje ngam anndugo lekki cuuɓaaki. Waddugo ɓingel asibiti ngam lartungo lawlaw woni kuugal boɗɗum je ɗon walla hisnugo yonki mako.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
reference: Daada, joodata ha  fattude amin. Do mari redu je mingel mako didabu. A fuddurde reedu mai komai oyaha daidai, odo nana beldum bingel feere do wara . Amma lewru sedda ko saalido ofuddi nanugo les reedu mako do naawa. Yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai, har daker o darata boddum. Nebai sam, bawo toin ofuddi rufugo eyam sosai . Rufugo eyam mai da no rufata don ba, rufi sosai kuma waati mo chomri odo Sommi. Dai o laari eyam mai, sai o hurtili taani don ko fe’di be bingel mako. Gorko mako yawi vallimo be yahi sibiti. Demde am kanju, dume don watata nawugo les reedu ha reedujo? Rufugo eyam sosai do alaama hattara don na je daada ko bingel ha redu mai? Dumedon alaama goddo laarata redu mai don damuwa? Don lekki je darnata naudum mai na be darna eyam mai je nawnata bingel mai?
model_answer: Ee, naawugo les reedu cattuɗum bee rufugo iiyam sosai nder lewru tataɓru ko alaama hattara mawɗum masin faa yonki daada e ɓingel. Ɗum ɗon holla koo reedu ndun ɗon pirlita (miscarriage) koo boo ɓingel ɗon mauna yaasi caski reedu (ectopic pregnancy), kanjum addata ɗuuɗɗal rafi iiyam e faddugo. Woodi lekki e baawɗe darnugo iiyam e naawɗum walaa bonnugo ɓingel, amma faa sai likita'en ngaɗi hoto reedu (scan) tawan ngam anndugo asali nyawu man e to ɓingel ngel ɗon mbeedi. Yaawugo yaargo mo sibiti ko gorko maako waɗi woni gataari burndi wooɗugo, ngam o nafee ɗon-e-ɗon bee ndiyam ɓandu (drip) koo ɓeydaari iiyam ngam hisnugo yonki maako.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel waawaa musuugo boɗɗum, ngel ɗon soma lawlaw ngam foofaango tiiɗungo ɗon haɗa ngel munyugo wakkati ngel ɗon hokka endi. Foofaango yaha dow jippa les bana doggudu bee ɓaandu wulndu ɗon holla alaama nyawu haatari bana pahuumbi (pneumonia) malla nyawu masiinji nder ƴiiƴam, naa ngam ngel musaay tati. Anniya daada ngel yahugo asibiti lawlaw ko huunde woodunde masin, ngam likita'en ɗon haaji lartugo ngel e hokka ngel lekki (antibiotics) malla hendu (oxygen) ngam hisnugo yonki maggel. Alaamaaji haatari ɗi daada e baaba poti hakkilango kofai kanjum woni to ɓingel salake musuugo, ɗon foofa lawlaw bee sembe, ɓaandu ɗon wula, malla ngel ɗon ɗaani masin walaa finka. Nder asibitiiji amin, min ɗon heba nyawuuji irin ɗi'i wakkati fuu, amma to baaba e daada waddi ɓingel lawlaw walaa ɓaawugo, insha Allahu ngel heɓan jam e kisndam.

model_answer: Ɓingel ngel don naawa nder hakkiilo mum ngam suna e taƴugo-ɓernde dow maayde inna maako, kanjum wadi o sali nyaamdu, o wowlataa, kadi o fijataa. question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. model_answer: Ɓingel keccel ngel ɗon mari caɗeele inneteeɗe *Birth Asphyxia*, waato ngel heɓaay hendu (oxygen) ko he'i nder ngaandi wakkati danygol, kanjum waɗi ngel wokkataa, ngel fofataa boɗɗum, kadi ɓandu maagel ɗon tiiɗi koo lo'i. Mataki jawjawri ko haani waɗeego kanjum on wuuwugo kine e hunnduko maagel, hokkugo ngel hendu jawjaw (resuscitation), e naadugo ngel nder dakiire asibiti keeriinde ngam ɓikkoi keccoy (SCBU) ngam ɗum faggitina ngel. Gooji (tests) ɗi haani waɗeego hawti e ƴeewugo sukkaari e mboowu (infection) nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel, bee ƴeewugo kalar ƴiiƴam daada (*blood group*) koo ɗon mari caɗeele liddiigo (Rh incompatibility) sabu ɓikkoi maako maayɓe ɓawo. E gandal am nder asibitiiji Afrik, booyugo wakkati danygol koo nyawu daada mo huraaka wakkati reedu (bana *syphilis*) ɓuri waddude irin lallibaaji ɗi. To ɓingel heɓi wallindeeki hendu e maagani jawjaw haa asibiti, ngel yamɗitay, ngaandi maagel fottitay kadi ngel fuɗɗan dimbugo e musinugo boɗɗum.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.

To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer: Nyawu nguli ɓandu, dimnugo, e naawol godi wakkere nyaamo kisa ɓaawo danyugo ɗon holla alamaaji *malaria* tsariindi malla nyawu mbuuɓri (sepsis/infection) nder ɓandu debbo danyiijo. *Paracetamol* e sha'i on mbaɗi ɗon usta nguli man seɗɗa, ammaa ɗum woppataa asali nyawu ngun, nden boo *infection* ɓaawo danyugo ɗon wondi e hatsari masin teema nanga koo ɓingel. Dole on yaara mo asibiti wakkati oon ngam likita'en mbaɗa *test* ƴiiƴam ngam tabintingo nyawu ngun, heɓa o heɓa lekki *antibiotics* malla *antimalarial* ko hawjata damuwa maako. Ɓingel ngel sali muusnugo ngam inna maagel walaa laaɓal ɓandu nden e nawra; to inna heɓi lekki asibiti laaɓtuɗum, o waran jam nden o waawa hokkaago ɓingel maako enɗam.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɗum ɓingel danyaangel ngel heɓaayi hendu poofirteeɗu (oxygen) wakkati danyeeki, anndiraaɗum 'Birth Asphyxia', nden ɗum haala cattuɗum masin haa ɓikkon kesso. 

Sadaare fooftugo, ɓanndu lo'undu (walaa semmbe), e jaasugo woyugo ɗon holla ɓingel ngel heɓaayi hendu foondaaku nder ɓanndu e ngaandi maagel. 

Taa hokku ngel lekki hunnduko malla ƴiiƴam jooni; ko ɓuri haaje lawlaw koo wulnugo ɓingel ngel, goggo poofirɗe maagel laaɓa, e huuturgo leemooru fooftinirndu ('Ambu bag') ngam wallugo ngel foofta. 

To ngel fuɗɗaayi fooftugo boɗɗum lawlaw, ngel haani lencineego haa heɓugo hendu oxygen e kakkilaaku likita'en ɓikkon kesso (neonatal care) nder asibiti. 

Nyawu ngu ɗon heewi heɓaade haa asibitiiji gure meeɗen, ammaa wallugo ngel foofta lawlaw (resuscitation) ɗon hisna yonki ɓingel ngam taa ngaandi maagel naawa koo maaya.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
reference:

Wakati feere daada bingel mai do changi. Debbo daade mako ko omari vodai. Denbo o handi daada bingel do odo mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha les jaaburu mako. Bo kullum to olaari alaamaji do berde mako do sakla. Odo tampi ko irin damuwaaji do nonnon fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don. Don yedde je o yahi sibiti, be odo volla be daadiraabe fere, sai o Nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fedata ha bandu mappe. Kanjum waddi mo odi olaara likita ovolwina be.

model_answer:
Alamaaji ɗi a limti ɗon holla masibo mawɗo; iyam wurtotoɗam be ketuuji, naawalla les jaaburu, e tampiri daada ɗon holla nyawu mboobu (infection) koo kedde danygol (retained placenta), nden ɓingel chanji e nguleefi ɗon holla ngel heɓi nyawu cemuɗam (neonatal sepsis). 

Taa yardu e haala rewɓe wiyooɓe ɗum mere, ngam ɗum naa al'aada ndiyam ɓaawo danygol boɗɗum; on danyi haaje yahaago asibiti wakkati oon ngam likita en ndaara daada e ɓingel. 

Zubar ƴiiƴam ɓaawo danygol e nyawu ɗon wadda naawalla reedu e soofugo ɓanndu, nden bo ɓikkoy keccoy ɗon yaawa waatugo to ɓe keɓi nyawu mboobu. 

Ngam faddugo ɗum, daada handi tokka laaɓal ɓanndu, jaɓa lekki ƴiiƴam, nden bo o yaha asibiti (postnatal care) ngam taa nyawu nanga mo koo ɓingel. 

Yawnee yahu asibiti wakkati oon ngam heɓugo laggol mboobu (antibiotics) e hisnugo yonki daada e keccel ngel.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
reference:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗi ɗo holla debbo o reedu on rufata (incomplete abortion), ngam lewru woyni mo lewru gootel e reeta, kadi o meeɗi rufugo reedu nde ɗiɗi ɓaawo. Kuje arande je waɗata lawlaw ngam hisnugo yonki maako kanjum on lornugo ndiyam ɓandu be leɗɗe rufa-rufa (IV fluids bana Normal Saline), e ƴeewugo ko o ɗon haaji ɓesdeego ƴiiƴam ngam iyam rufi sosai. Batteji (injections) je darnata iyam man kanjum on Oxytocin malla Ergometrine, ko kuroje wiyeteɗe Misoprostol je wallata reedu fasa ndarna iyam rufugo. To reedu man laaɓai pat, likita'en doole naftira be kuugal pamaral wiyeteengal Manual Vacuum Aspiration (MVA) ngam laɓɓinugo nder reedu maako heɓa rufugo iyam man daro fey. Ɓaawo ɗon, o hokkete lekki mboondi (antibiotics) ngam haɗugo kure, kadi o hositee yeeso ngam bincike anndugo ko saabata o rufa reedu koo-nde-to heɓa o wallitee.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. model_answer: Alaamuuji ɗi a limti, bana ɓuuɗugo yeeso e kosɗe, naawalla hoore tiiɗka, gite daari-daari, e ɓamtol sembe ƴiiƴam (high BP), ɗon holla nyawu masibo bi'eteengu *severe pre-eclampsia* (hawugo ƴiiƴam mawngu ngam reedu). Ɗum nyawu nguuɗingu masin, ngam to o heɓaay lekki law-law, ɗum waawata addango mo pampo (fijugo koo convulsions) koo maayde mako e ɓinngel nder reedu. Mataki maapindiiji wakkatiire nde'e kanjum on yaargo mo asibiti mawɗo wakkati oon ngam likita'en pukkina mo (admission). Haa asibiti, ɓe lokka mo leɗɗe nder ƴiiƴam (bana *Magnesium sulfate*) ngam haɗugo pampo, ɓe jippina sembe ƴiiƴam mako. Lekki nyawu ngu'u timmungu kanjum on danyingo ɓinngel ngel wakkati oon, koo e seƴugo (operation), ngam hisnugo yonki inna e ɓinngel.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am  bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. Dai mi ummi, sai don miyahi sibiti mi emma ko diyam labdam je mi naftiri ta mi yiwa be mai kanjum don waddata kala yeu bawo dayugo.
model_answer: Ee, ndiyam dotti ɗam a naftirta kanjum waddi nyawu (infection) haa nder ɓandu ma, ngam laawol danygol ma selaay tawan nden bo mbuuwi nasti. Alamaji ɗi a wolwi bana jangol, dimugo, haccenga iyam danygol, e iilde gite, ɗon holla a heɓi nyawu mangu e masibo ɓawo danygol (puerperal sepsis). Hootu asibiti lawlaw jotta ngam likitooki en kooka ma lekki (antibiotics) koo nyawu ngu ɓesda hallugo haa wadda maayde. Haa yeeso, to on wala ndiyam laɓɗam haa fattude mooɗon, saa'a fuu on defa ndiyam wula nguldam masin de on acca ɗam ɓuuɓa koo a yiiwa e mun. Laɓɓingo ɓandu bee ndiyam laɓɗam ɗon mballa faddago nyawuuji bonɗi ɗi tawan wara ɓawo danygol.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.
reference:
Addirawo am dayi bingel debbo balde sali ,sai o lari ba kala wakkati o misinta mo o wala fofa boddum,wakkati fere bingel man yofta ta kossam bamo pofde mako ta ee,yenda wore,dada bingel timmini musungo mo be jemma,sai o lari lebbi bingel ba wailiti sedda sedda,sai o tampi ko o wadata,sai o godi bamtugo bingel mai gam o heba o fofa boddum,amma bo bingel gagiri fofugo boddum,be bo chanjugo lebbi bingel man,sai o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be larinamo bingel mai,

Dume on aagaji be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone
model_answer: Wailitiggo leɓɓi ɓingel laata ɓaleeji (cyanosis) e tampiri fofugo wakkati musinngo ɗon holla ƴiiƴam maako walaa hendu (oxygen) heƴiyandu; ɗum ɓurna fuu alama nyau ɓerde danyaangol (congenital heart disease) malla nyau pofɗe mawngu addata ɗum, naa nyau asma. Alaamaaji kalluɗi ɗi saruuji poti watta hakkilo e muɗum ngoni: fofugo jaawngo, looreego gaarol wakkati fofugo, woppugo musinngo, e wailitiggo leɓɓi malla ɓanndu laato ɓaleejum. Agaje (first aid) gaw-gaw to ɓingel fofata be bone woni ɓamtugo mo o daroo dow wulo daada maako ngam laawol hendu maako maɓɓita, taa doole musina mo nden bo fakkugo mo limse ngam o waasa jaangol. Diga ɗon, doole yaaru mo asibiti mawndo law-law ngam likita'en mbaɗana mo hendu oxygen, ɓe ƴeewa koo asali bone man na nyau ɓerde danyaangol ngam o heɓa safaara dacitiindo.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. Emol hado ɗume on waddini debbo redul jodo fiyel berde be lau lau do a viya mo timmini dogugo dembo dume on sanadu uppugo dande do irin nyau do kam wawan mema maunugo bingel redu mako do na dume on alamaji kalludum je be watinta gite hasare ba irin nyamduji ko kuje yare yareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko beddata nyamugo ha irin wakkati do.
reference:
Debbo Jomu redu reduman lebbi jego,mindo wondi sare gotel,fuddi hirrugo do berde mako do fiya be lau lau,aviya mo timmini dongugo jotta,wakkati fere bo o do soma ko o huwai ko dume,denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda,satiji sali sedda o lari dade mako do uppa heddi yeso,sai o hultiri,o do nummado kam do der yauwu damata jomu redu nah ko bo dum yauwu fere on,sai o taski yehugo lara likita gam andugo dume sanadu yauw do.
Yammol ha do ,dume on waddini debbo redujo do fiyal berde be lau lau do aviya bo timmini doggugo?
